name: end card: icon mark, kicker and an underlined closing line
looks: A simple geometric icon mark sits centred above a small spaced-out kicker line naming the category. A bold closing headline settles beneath both, and a hairline draws under part of it for emphasis.
build: The icon and kicker arrive together, y:8-12px->0, opacity 0->1, power2.out; the headline follows as one settled block, no per-letter stagger; the underline is a scaleX reveal from the left under the emphasised phrase, landing just after the headline settles.
sound: A soft low swell fading out under the hold, a light tick as the underline draws.
prompt: Close on a simple icon mark and a small spaced-out category kicker settling together above a bold closing claim. Draw a hairline under the most important phrase in that claim just after it lands, and hold the finished card without further motion.
